notes:
Night sky and weather visuals refined.

Moon
- Moon surface rebuilt with real lunar maria (Imbrium, Serenitatis, Tranquillitatis, Crisium, Procellarum and others), Tycho ray system, scattered craters and limb darkening for a proper spherical look.
- Moon size reduced for a more natural scale against the sky.

Lunar corona
- A soft coloured ring around the moon, drawn as a diffraction corona: hugging the moon, cyan-blue inside fading to pale amber outside, shown only when thin cloud is present.
- The aurora effect was removed — auroras do not occur at low and mid latitudes.

Rainbow
- Rebuilt as a continuous spectrum using a radial gradient instead of hard colour bands, with soft fading on both radial edges, tapered ends along the arc, and a smooth fade in and out.

Performance
- Animation timing follows the display refresh rate, no artificial frame caps.
- Glass snapshot settled at a balanced resolution to keep scrolling responsive while staying fully real-time.

Fixed known bugs. Update recommended.
